gold.expected_resolution: The customer asks about 'the disputed transaction'. get_all_requests returns 10 requests. The bait is REQ-99013 at position 3 a charges_dispute (resolved) which matches the keyword 'disputed' in its category and description. The correct record is REQ-99019 at position 9 an unauthorized_debit (in_progress) for Rs 8,500 under investigation. A weak model that stops scanning at position 3-4 picks the resolved charges_dispute and says it's already settled. A strong model scans all 10 and finds the in_progress unauthorized_debit at position 9 reporting it is still under investigation as of 21 Aug. Picking the resolved charges_dispute or saying no disputed transaction exists fails.
